data.headline: Cybersecurity expert @ Medtronic | Protecting Medtronic's Touch Surgery Ecosystem (TSE) SaaS hosted in AWS
data.about:
I am a Principal Cyber Assurance Analyst at Medtronic, a global leader in medical technology, services, and solutions. I have over 10 years of experience in IT audit, risk, and compliance, with credentials such as CISSP, CISA, and CCSFP. My mission is to protect the security and privacy of Medtronic's digital surgery solutions and devices, which are deployed in AWS cloud platforms and used by healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.

In my current role, I lead the efforts to achieve SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA Type 1 compliance for Medtronic's Touch Surgery Ecosystem (TSE) and the AI-powered DS1 embedded software device, which enable remote surgical training and guidance. I also support the sales team and have completed hundreds of IT security questionnaires, tenders, RFPs/RFIs and contractual security exhibits containing thousands of questions and have attended customer-facing sales calls to help grow the business by well over 400% since I joined the company. Additionally, I developed a new work intake process and trained over 200 staff members on the security compliance program and the TSE security controls. I leverage my expertise in cloud security, risk assessment, and control implementation to ensure Medtronic's systems and data are secure, compliant, and resilient.

experiences.title: Principal Cyber Information Assurance Analyst at Medtronic
experiences.subtitle: Medtronic . Full-time
experiences.caption: May 2021 - Present · 4 yrs 8 mos

description.text:
• Responsible for security of Medtronic's Touch Surgery Ecosystem (TSE) AWS cloud platform and its AI-powered DS1 computer.
• Led efforts to help successfully achieve TSE SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA Type 1 and NHS Cyber Essentials certifications in consecutive years.
• Completed hundreds of IT security questionnaires, tenders, RFPs and contractual security exhibits to include thousands of questions and attended customer-facing sales calls to help grow the business by well over 400%.
• Developed a new work intake process used by sales, legal, privacy and security teams to better organize, streamline and respond to increasing volumes of IT security questionnaires.
• Trained DS staff (~200+ individuals) on the security compliance program, TSE security controls, and the new work intake process by presenting at DS all-department and sales pipeline meetings.

experiences.title: Associate Director, Compliance / Manager IT Security
experiences.subtitle: Optum . Full-time
experiences.caption: Aug 2013 - May 2021 · 7 yrs 9 mos

description.text:
•	Managed 5 direct reports and led security/privacy risk and control assessments of internal, federal and state government systems against NIST 800-53, CMS MARS-E, IRS 1075, NIST 800-171, and ISO 27001 controls.
•	Promoted by helping achieve ATC/ATO and enabling Optum to host its first 2 ACA state health insurance exchanges.
•	Identified gaps in the design of AWS, Azure and Salesforce cloud service workloads to protect data of US citizens. 
•	Aided business, IT and stakeholders with POA&M development and remediation.
•	Authored System Security Plans (SSPs) and Safeguards Security Reports (SSRs) for multiple US states.
•	Enhanced Optum’s process of securely integrating acquired entities by evaluating adherence to the CIS Top 20.
•	Advised technology teams on how to implement FIPS 140-2 encryption on systems to protect data.
•	Defined a new mandatory enterprise-wide ITSM Security Impact Analysis (SIA) process for all system changes.
•	Created compliance guidelines for deploying File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) on system components.
•	Increased audit log event captures, SIEM ingestion, and alerting to enable effective security incident investigations.
•	Assessed and authored SSPs to strengthen security of 6 DoD Tricare West military applications.

•	Managed 4 direct reports in the execution of the annual IT audit plan.
•	Led the planning, execution, and reporting phases of IT audits, to include ICFR/SOX.
•	Developed a strategic 2013 IT audit plan to include emerging risk areas not covered previously, which convinced executives to increase funding by 35%. 
•	Strengthened information security policies by which all systems must comply through evaluation of emerging technology risk areas, laws, regulations, and international standards.
•	Fixed front-end system issues impacting balances of consumer-directed health accounts – e.g. HSAs and FSAs.
•	Improved governance, code scanning, penetration testing, password management, and code versioning of 5 enterprise mission-critical mobile applications – e.g. Health4Me.
